title: Exact derandomization of logarithmic space: ` L=RL=BPL`

result.label: Exact derandomization of logarithmic space: ` L=RL=BPL`
result.statement: Proves L= RL = BPL , resolving derandomization for bounded-error logarithmic-space computation. An effective compiler converts each randomized polynomial-time logarithmic-space machine deciding a language with one-sided or two-sided error into a deterministic logarithmic-space decider with explicit polynomial running-time bounds.
